findings.title: Exported receiver: androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallReceiver
findings.fix: Keep the android:permission guard, and check the guarded permission is not itself granted to untrusted apps.

findings.title: Application allows backup
findings.evidence: android:allowBackup=true in <application> — app data can be pulled off with 'adb backup'.
findings.fix: Set android:allowBackup=false unless backup is a feature users need.

findings.title: Unprotected deep link: markor://
findings.evidence: Exported activity net.gsantner.markor.activity.DocumentActivity handles scheme 'markor://' (host open) — any app on the device can open it, with no permission check.
findings.fix: Protect the activity with android:permission, verify the link (App Links with assetlinks.json) instead of a bare custom scheme, or set android:exported=false.

findings.title: No network security config — cleartext defaults apply
findings.evidence: No res/xml/network_security_config.xml, and android:usesCleartextTraffic is not false — cleartext traffic is governed by the platform default, not by an explicit policy.
findings.fix: Add a network security config that forbids cleartext, or set android:usesCleartextTraffic=false.
